title: Lost Vape Kata Replacement 10+2 Pods - 0.8ohm
description: Keep your Kata device performing at its very best with the Lost Vape Kata 10+2 Refillable Pods. Designed exclusively for the Lost Vape Kata Pod Kit, these replacement cartridges feature an innovative 10+2 capacity system. This smart modular design combines a standard 2ml viewing pod with an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, allowing you to load up to 12ml of your favourite e-liquid at one time for extended, uninterrupted vaping. Equipped with a built-in 0.8ohm mesh coil, these pods deliver outstanding flavour and a consistently smooth draw. The integrated coil design completely eliminates the need for messy coil changes; simply replace the entire pod unit when the coil reaches the end of its lifespan. Perfectly suited for both Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) and Restricted Direct-To-Lung (RDL) vaping styles, these pods are highly optimised for use with 50VG/50PG e-liquids, including popular nicotine salts and freebase formulas. Finally, the secure magnetic connection ensures the pod sits firmly in the device while making swaps incredibly quick and simple. Supplied in a convenient pack of two. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
